reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model PA-10, which is a recalled model.
The date code 2126 is within the recalled range of 2126 to 2319.
The purchase was at Amazon.com, a listed retailer, on 2022-02-20, inside the sale window of 2021-06-01 to 2023-11-30. No receipt is required for this retailer and window.
No other claim shares a photo, address, email, serial, or payout account with this one.

The serial check was skipped and returned no verdict, so the serial was not verified against the recalled ranges. The model, date code, and purchase checks all support eligibility, so I approved, but the serial gap is noted for follow-up.
The claimant requested repair or replacement, not a refund, so no destruction proof is required and the value threshold does not apply.
